prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: fetch-highword
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): f0598affde498574
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
mem_valid is inverted on instruction/data launch, hanging fetch at max_addr=0x00000000 with TRAP no progress. Line 584 drives mem_valid <= mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word (0 for normal fetch) while line 598 asserts mem_valid == !mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word (1 for normal fetch). The missing `!` means normal fetches never start a bus transfer and prefetched-high-word fetches spuriously do, stalling compressed prefetch.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash f0598affde498574 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
